quantifier_order: Retain the original Host/Datum/Level, every prescribed complex base embedding and ordered type.
For arithmetic model construction retain the same fixed Gm and xi, then construct an exact integral model for each original datum of the same signature.
Choose the transvection modulus before every isotropic lattice vector, real integral scalar and either kappa sign.
For every supplied FamilyUnif choose ModelsOf on the same fixed Gm/xi with exact principal groups.
Construct LatZ for every original component family and every rank; construct ExpoMatch for every cusp and rho of an original ModelBase when A=1.
Given all original compatible f_n and nu_n, construct each moduli point with every positive torsion level, every scalar extension C -> k, and the original two markings.
Do not interchange these individual constructions with existence of a finite holomorphic FamilyUnif or its normalized framed points.

not_supplied: The supplied original Host, Datum, Level and Moduli record are retained; no common field or representing moduli scheme is constructed.

N1c is not closed. Reverse uniformization at an arbitrary given moduli point, local period lifting with the prescribed initial period, holomorphic moduli/exponential dependence for arbitrary period families, the simultaneous theta frame and finite-family assembly remain.
PUN11 constructs ModelsOf/ModelBase/NegXi for a supplied FamilyUnif; it does not choose or prove that family.

FramesOK, CoverTri and FibTri remain: simultaneous normalized framed points, the exact Gaussian mean norm, all triangular weight characters, arithmetic invariance, readings, cover and fiber comparison on the same family.
The final IsUnf and FromTest dictionary must use the same constructed framed points. The complete FrameUnif.exists_unf_hasPrinc endpoint is not supplied.
The same common field/metric/measure/phase obligations, unconditional full LatFull, higher CoversAt, all-tuple ClsEx/PointIdentCore/ClassSumsSpan, and full RH/GRH are not inferred.
